title: Adopt llms.txt and llms-full.txt machine-readable documentation manifests
rationale: While not a defect, emerging AI indexing standards (llms.txt) provide concise markdown summaries and curated link maps specifically tailored for Large Language Model retrieval and RAG context windows, giving Mozilla a direct channel to control how AI engines summarize its product portfolio, open-source governance, and privacy manifestos.

suggested_action.summary: Publish /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt summarizing Mozilla's mission, products, and documentation links.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Deploy a concise /llms.txt at the root of mozilla.org linking to markdown-formatted summaries of Firefox, Mozilla VPN, Mozilla Monitor, MDN, and the Mozilla Manifesto.

title: Implement Schema.org FAQPage markup on product feature and support pages
rationale: Mozilla's product pages provide clear answers to common user questions (e.g. server count, device limits, privacy guarantees, logging policies). Wrapping these existing Q&A sections in FAQPage JSON-LD allows AI assistants and search engines to directly extract authoritative answers for high-intent conversational queries.

suggested_action.summary: Embed FAQPage JSON-LD on high-intent product FAQ sections.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add FAQPage schema with Question and Answer mainEntity pairs on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ and related product FAQ sections.

title: Introduce cross-product account status and session continuation cues on mozilla.org
rationale: Mozilla operates an interconnected suite of privacy tools (Firefox, VPN, Monitor, Relay, MDN Plus) linked by Mozilla Accounts (FxA). Surfacing personalized sign-in state or contextual continuation prompts on mozilla.org helps returning users immediately access their active subscriptions and privacy dashboards, reducing conversion friction.

suggested_action.summary: Surface Mozilla Account sign-in indicators and direct dashboard shortcuts on the main domain.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a lightweight account avatar/status indicator in the global header linked to the Mozilla Accounts dashboard (accounts.firefox.com) when an active session is detected.
